summary.text: Carlos Gonzalez is a Republican candidate for the New Hampshire House of Representatives, Hillsborough 40, in the November 3, 2026 general election, and a former member of the Manchester Board of School Committee.
He previously served in the state House from 2010 to 2012 and 2014 to 2016.

paragraphs.text: Gonzalez earned a B.A. from Catholic University, Santiago-Dominican Republic in 1981 and an M.S. from the University of New Hampshire in 1987, according to Ballotpedia.

His professional experience includes work in the mortgage business, teaching and administrative roles at Franklin Pierce College, project director work at Plymouth State College, and positions at the U.S. Embassy and the presidency's technical secretariat in the Dominican Republic.
Ballotpedia says he and his wife, Loretta, have four children.
Gonzalez served in the New Hampshire House representing Hillsborough 17 from 2010 to 2012 and Hillsborough 45 from 2014 to 2016.
He won the Ward 12 seat on the Manchester Board of School Committee in the nonpartisan election of November 2, 2021, defeating Kenneth Roy, and held it until 2026.
Gonzalez was a Republican candidate in Hillsborough 40 in 2022 and 2024 and did not win either general election.
He advanced from the September 8, 2026 Republican primary.
